job.name: ig27_girl
job.person_note: A completely new, ordinary young woman (not a celebrity, not a model), looks genuinely real.
job.meaning: девушка ~25 снимает себя в машине: светлые волосы в небрежном пучке, белый пуховик, петличка-микрофон в руке
job.prompt: Photorealistic vertical 9:16 selfie-style video frame: a friendly Russian young woman about 25 with light-blonde hair in a messy bun, no heavy makeup, a white puffer jacket, sitting in the driver's seat of a car, filming herself, holding a small white wireless clip-on microphone near her chin. Close-medium shot, shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge, looking straight into the lens, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, curious expression, NO smile. Background: car interior with light seats and an overcast autumn street through the window, soft daylight. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.

attempts.issue: Hair bun cropped at top edge and mouth in puckered speaking pose
